jobs.title: REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS Maine Municipal Planning & GIS Consultants Raymond, Maine
jobs.description:
**REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS**

*Maine Municipal Planning & GIS Consultants*

Raymond, Maine — Open Space Plan Update

PDF proposals due October 16, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern—two weeks before the Town’s October 30 deadline.

I am seeking a qualified Maine municipal planner and GIS specialist—or a firm providing both—to join a proposed team updating Raymond’s 2009 Open Space Plan and aligning it with the 2025 Comprehensive Plan.

This is a prospective paid consulting/subconsulting opportunity, contingent on Town award and an agreed contract. It is not a Town employment vacancy; no award has been secured.

SCOPE

- Review plans and update open-space/natural-resource inventories.

- Develop GIS datasets and conservation, recreation, stewardship and connectivity maps.

- Support public outreach, an early community session and prioritized implementation/funding recommendations.

- Support Conservation Commission review and Select Board presentation.

QUALIFICATIONS

- Comparable planning experience for Maine municipalities of similar size and character.

- Knowledge of Maine land-use, conservation and municipal planning.

- GIS analysis, cartography, metadata and Town-compatible deliverables in Maine State Plane, NAD83, feet.

- Public-engagement skills, availability and applicable insurance.

Planning, GIS or combined proposals welcome. Remote analysis is anticipated; in-person needs remain subject to confirmation.

SEND A SEARCHABLE PDF

To Zach Stevenson: [zach.stevenson907@gmail.com](mailto:zach.stevenson907@gmail.com)

Subject: Raymond Open Space Plan — Planning/GIS Proposal

Include contact details, proposed role, résumés, 2–3 comparable Maine projects with dates/status, scale and your role; 3 references; approach/deliverables; task/staff hours, rates, expenses and total fee; availability; insurance and conflicts, including any independent bid.

[RFP: Raymond Open Space Plan Update](https://lnkd.in/gp-SKgTs]

Send questions needing Town clarification by October 12. Early introductions welcome. No SSNs or bank statements.

#MainePlanning #GIS #ConsultingOpportunity

Sources

* [1] Raymond\_Open\_Space\_Plan\_RFP.pdf https://lnkd.in/g57xvBCx

Pay: $30.00 - $100.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote
